title: Invoices now specify when they’re finalized alongside other status transitions
summary: Moves the finalized_at property for invoices into the status_transitions hash.

migrationNotes.text: This change moves the finalized_at property for invoices into the new status_transitions hash. You now need to access the finalization timestamp through status_transitions.finalized_at instead of directly from the Invoice object. This modification organizes invoice status change information more coherently.
